items.prompt: Before a new value 3, the prefix contains three separate occurrences of 7 and the target is 10. How many pairs does this arrival add?

options.why: Each earlier occurrence of 7 forms a different position pair with this 3.
A set would report membership but discard threefold multiplicity.
7+3 equals 10, so these earlier complements all qualify.
The later endpoint is fixed; no second orientation is added.
